description: Reviewer-model configuration for tools/review-execution.py. provider is 'anthropic' (Claude Messages API, default) or 'openai' (OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint). No secrets in this file: the API key is read from the environment variable named in api_key_env (or a KEY=VALUE entry in ./.env). For Muse Wonder instead: provider 'openai', api_url 'https://api.meta.ai/v1/chat/completions', model 'muse-wonder-1.0', api_key_env 'MODEL_API_KEY'.
